candidate_headline: Evolutionary memory is hierarchical rather than scale-optimal.
conceptual_claim: Coarse phenotype states can retain broad historical structure while finer states preserve additional phylogenetic organization inside those coarse states; consequently no single global resolution must maximize evolutionary signal.

tier_A_standardized_visible_same_estiman.estimator: within-coarse same-fine ROC_AUC centered on within-coarse label-permutation null

tier_B_biochemical_same_estimand.estimator: same within-coarse conditional ROC_AUC and fine-label permutation logic
tier_B_biochemical_same_estimand.inference: cross-representation biochemical concordance under the same conceptual estimand
limitations: not independent of existing Petunieae profile

tier_C_external_independent_conditional_.estimator_family: conditional fine-state phylogenetic organization with system-specific source-faithful statistics
tier_C_external_independent_conditional_.inference: independent radiation-level qualitative replication of conditional fine-state organization
limitations: do not pool p-values or sensitivity trees as independent biological units

tier_D_prospective_falsification_gate.prediction: if fine-to-coarse opportunity exists, fine biochemical states will show positive within-coarse hidden memory under 9999 frozen permutations
tier_D_prospective_falsification_gate.pass_rule: observed conditional AUC > permutation mean and one-sided permutation p <= 0.05

relation_to_memory_architecture.amplitude: how much evolutionary history remains overall
relation_to_memory_architecture.global_scale_tilt: where that history is most visible under global coarse-versus-fine comparison
relation_to_memory_architecture.hierarchical_hidden_memory: whether fine identity retains additional phylogenetic organization after coarse membership is fixed
relation_to_memory_architecture.key_result: hidden memory is empirically distinct from both amplitude and global scale tilt

explains_prior_negative_results: The failed universal intermediate optimum does not imply absence of structure; intermediate curvature is a minor profile axis.
No universal coarse/fine winner is expected if global scale tilt and hidden within-state organization are separate quantities.
A clade can be globally coarse-tilted yet retain positive fine-level memory within coarse states.
Representation opportunity determines whether hidden fine structure can exist, while phylogenetic realization determines whether it is actually organized.
strongest_current_positive_statement: Flower-color evolution repeatedly preserves nested historical information: finer phenotype identity can remain phylogenetically organized within coarser states across standardized visible-color clades, a biochemical Petunieae hierarchy, and three independent external radiations, although prospective cross-representation validation is still pending.
not_allowed: pooled significance across nonexchangeable evidence tiers
claim that retrospective Petunieae or external systems are prospective validation
claim that hierarchical memory has one ecological or molecular cause
modification of frozen EL v0.3 in place
next_gate: Resolve the Ruellia authoritative-tree provenance without opening HPLC outcomes, then execute the already-frozen prospective hidden-memory test unchanged.
